criteria.description: Video length is approximately 3 minutes and does not exceed 4 minutes.

categories.scoring_instructions: If the criteria is met, full points are awarded. Deduct 1/3 for 4min10sec, then additionally 1/3 point for each additional 30 seconds.

criteria.description: Audio narration of the tasks and actions being demonstrated are provided.
Audio narration is clear and audible.

categories.scoring_instructions: If the criteria is met, full points are awarded. If narration is provided but not clear or audible, half points are awarded. If narration is not provided, 0 points are awarded.

criteria.description: Video should include moving images that demonstrate the skills the student is trying to teach.
Video quality is good (greater than 480p).
Screen resolution is sufficient for readability of data.
Does not use a hand held camera (cell phone) to record the screen.
Webcam image does not block an important part of the demonstration.

categories.scoring_instructions: If all the criteria are met, full points are awarded. If there are no moving images, award 0. If the video quality is not good, subtract 3/20. If the screen resolution is not sufficient, subtract 5/20. If a hand held camera (cell phone) is used to record the computer screen, subtract 10/20. If the webcam image blocks an important part of the demonstration, subtract 2/20. Minimum score is 0.
